content:
Deletes a folder. If you delete a folder that contains scans, Tenable Web App Scanning automatically
moves those scans to the Trash folder. You cannot delete Tenable-provided folders or custom folders
that belong to other users (even if you use an administrator account).
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE  custom role privilege. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
Example: d30881ae-6b5c-4b1e-ad60-f2643d0da492
The UUID of the folder.
